nodes.label: Presigned URL TTLs (5m PUT / 15m GET)
nodes.rationale: presignPutTTL 5m and presignGetTTL 15m default via Config.ApplyDefaults; short PUT window limits exposure of write capability while GETs live long enough to render the gallery.

nodes.label: Internal vs public storage endpoint split
nodes.norm_label: internal vs public storage endpoint split
nodes.rationale: S3Store keeps two clients: an internal endpoint for Head/Delete and a publicEndpoint for presigning, because SigV4 signs the host so the presigned URL the browser receives must use a browser-reachable host.
